reference_basis.instruction: Preserve Ayami's visible facial identity and characteristic hair baseline. The image shows only an upper-body/waist crop, so it does not independently establish stature or leg proportions. Exclude office wardrobe, jewellery, background, posture, and polished studio lighting from permanent identity.

face_geometry.description: Soft slender oval face, moderately longer than wide, with gentle vertical length rather than a short or round facial silhouette. High-mid cheekbones are visible but softly defined, flowing into a smooth narrowing jaw and a small rounded-to-subtly-pointed chin. Her face should read delicate and refined without becoming childlike, overly narrow, or sharply angular.

eyes.description: Deep dark-brown elongated almond eyes with approximately average spacing, clear tapered inner corners, gently tapered outer corners, and a level-to-slightly lifted orientation. The eyes have a restrained horizontal shape rather than a large round appearance. Preserve natural East Asian eyelid anatomy, subtle upper-lid definition, realistic eye size, and the calm attentive quality of her gaze.

brows.description: Dark-brown medium-full eyebrows with a natural low gentle arch, softly structured inner brows, clean tapered tails, and moderate separation from the eyes. Avoid exaggerated high arches, very thin brows, or heavy block-shaped brows.

nose.description: Slim-to-medium straight nasal bridge with moderate projection, a compact softly rounded tip, and narrow natural nostril width. The nose remains proportionate to the narrow jaw and elongated eyes, neither extremely small nor strongly projected.

mouth.description: Medium-width mouth with smooth medium-full natural lips, a subtle cupid's bow, balanced upper and lower lip volume, and a slightly fuller lower lip. At rest the mouth remains soft and composed; when smiling, the corners rise gently without dramatically widening the face.

skin.description: Light warm-neutral complexion with realistic natural skin texture, slight tonal variation, and a healthy soft finish rather than porcelain smoothness. Preserve the small beauty mark below the left eye when clearly visible and consistent with the camera angle.

hair.description: Long, thick very dark espresso-brown hair that can appear nearly black in shadow while retaining a subtle brown cast in brighter light. The hair carries loose natural S-wave through the lengths, with a center-to-soft-off-centre part, airy curtain fringe, and fine wispy face-framing strands. Preserve the dark colour, long length, density, and soft movement even when the hairstyle changes.

body_proportions.description: Medium-tall lean softly athletic feminine frame with graceful upright carriage, gently defined shoulders, a slim but healthy torso, defined waist, naturally feminine hips, and long balanced legs. Toned without appearing heavily muscular, frail, underweight, or exaggeratedly curvy.
